steps.text: 17 Years Ago
1:37 P.M. \ Clear
Central Ursus, Pine Valley Retreat, Dining Hall

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sir, your coffee.

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: —Are you new?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am, sir.

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Then ask around about how I take my coffee. Bring it to me again once you let it cool!

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: You damned Feline—eugh, a Feline! You disgusting wretch! I didn't go to war to have a Feline take care of me!

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Get out of my sight!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: My utmost apologies, sir, this is my oversight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please don't tell the head caretaker. I'll prepare it again for you right away...

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Hmph! If you don't want to lose your job, you have three minutes to do it over, properly.

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Also... is something wrong with your eyes? If you don't know how to smile, I'll tear that face of yours off.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please don't... I'm very sorry to displease you. I'll go and redo it right now.

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Peh. Servants these days. Is a nice figure all they have to offer?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am very sorry, sir. Please do not get angry.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would be highly detrimental to your condition.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, yes. Very sorry.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Miss? Hey, Miss!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you referring to me?

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Yeah, that's right. Miss, I saw the whole thing just now. Don't you lose heart.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: That's a Patrol Unit head... you know, you could say, people like that have no right coming to the retreat.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He certainly isn't a noble... Does he not worry about offending others, acting so tyrannically?

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: They say some count's very fond of him... ah, and not just that. Coming here for his 'battlefield condition?' I heard that's hokum. Bet he hasn't stepped foot on a battlefield in his life.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: I heard he helped the count do some dirty work, and got sent here so he could keep his head down. With a supporter like that, and with people like us, of course he lets all hell's bells loose.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...A count...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I never imagined a scoundrel like that could climb high enough to befriend a count.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: That's how it is! Who knows when one day he'll be made some lord of somewhere! Dressed all clean and fine and sitting behind some enormous desk... agh.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Anyway, don't you get angry. Piss off people like that, and you'll wish it was an Originium Slug stuck to you instead. What on Terra is a fine young girl like you even doing, working out here...

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Never tell anyone I told you this, and don't go asking about, or else you'll get burnt!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes... I understand. Thank you.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Ack. The next you see him, stay away a little. Heaven knows what he'll do to you—ah, is that the new doctor?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Oh, oh, so you know each other... then I'll get out of your way. Definitely not break time, after all. Take care, and don't let the head caretaker see you.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: She cares a lot about us newcomers. She's a good one.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're right, Dr. Louisa. We cannot let her down.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Will you still be busy with work in a bit? There's some things I'd like to tell you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Apologies, doctor... I still need to brew a new cup of coffee. If that count's pet doesn't continue to pick bones with me, I'll find you right after.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Alright, then... remember to be careful, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. Louisa.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: It's just us two right now, Kal'tsit. You should be using an alias.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Louisa.' Borrowing your daughter's name. A disguise of that level is purely for humiliating the Secret Police.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In their eyes, I am already dead. And after this incident, I'll leave Ursus, and may not be able to return for a very long time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nobody will know the Grand Duke's death was a murder. The next time they come to the Grand Duke's side, they will only discover that in his old age, his breathing stopped.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Will Ursus technology not be enough to analyze the poison you've made?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At present, I assure you this exceeds their understanding of what a 'poison' is.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: For how many years can your knowledge stay ahead of Ursus? Director?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Empire's progress has already surpassed what I imagined, but these are not details we need to discuss right now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lillia, your hoped-for arbitration can only end in this way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: None of you have the means to seek further revenge; it is unreasonable. Only the paramount Emperor of Ursus would be capable of erasing the Grand Duke's honor, significance, and all else.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: ...I know...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good. In that case, is this the place?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Yes. We have no idea what Grand Duke Vanya is chronically afflicted with.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: But I found out from the head caretaker that every afternoon at three, Vanya will leave his own monitoring room, and come here to relax.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: He sunbathes here until sunset. When he has the occasional guests, he'll have his dinner right here with them.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: There's no way we can get close to the Grand Duke's room, but as for here...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're standing right here.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: But he won't be without bodyguards. The whole corridor will be sealed off when the time comes.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Apart from any guests cleared to be with the Grand Duke, only his medical adviser, as well as the servants, are allowed to enter this area.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even so, the Ursus nobles won't permit the workers to come to this balcony freely.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've already waited for long enough. The longer we spend, the riskier this gets.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I understand. There has to be some gap, there has to be an opening... the Grand Duke's medical advisers work in shifts, so it might be me before we know it. Today, or perhaps tomorrow.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lillia, tell me the truth.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After the Grand Duke dies, what will you do?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Why ask this now? We should be focusing on what's before us—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm hoping you can answer me with reality.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Before we reached Pine Valley, I received one final letter from Vampilov's family.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Sergei is still diligently serving Boris, and the city... has changed course. Perhaps this is the start of something changing.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: They killed so many people... yet their conscience is still so clear. They rest so easily...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You found out about Sergei's betrayal.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: But no excuse can bring back the dead.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Sergei can't offer any further scientific assistance. Perhaps in a few years, they'll formally call a halt to the project. And then? I just sit back and watch Sergei and Boris continue to collude, to trample over everything?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Though Grand Duke Vanya will be dead, you don't plan to stop.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: There's no way I can pardon Sergei. The first time I met him, Astrov was drunk, hugging me so excited, telling me all about how he had such upstanding, excellent colleagues.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: He looked forward to this project like no one else, and I supported him. I supported him with all I could.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Even up to now.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Director Kal'tsit, you know everything, don't you?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: If you won't speak up, I'll return to Chernobog. I'll settle things once and for all.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Vampilov's family have an escape route to Sami ready for me, but maybe, I wouldn't get the chance to hitchhike with any Messengers. And you...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I do plan to.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Heh... of course.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I'm very well aware, I'm setting myself alight. So... Kal'tsit, no matter whether you plan to confess all the facts to me or not, at the very least there's one tiny thing I want you to agree to.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I know I'm doing something insane right now, and I know maybe you're the one in the right. But right now, I only have one request. Look after my daughter. Look after Louisa.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: The next generation doesn't need to inherit the hassle of hatred... Even if nobody can escape this cycle in the end, at least promise me, Kal'tsit. Look after her. If you can, please look after Lyudmila too...

steps.name: Caretaker's Voice
steps.text: Dr. Louisa? Dr. Louisa, where are you?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Here! Please wait one moment!

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Kal'tsit... I...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I promise you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is simply a mother's final wish. I will see Louisa grow up.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Astrov—the last time he held little Louisa's hand, he told me something, half-jokingly.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: He said, he hoped little Louisa would become a medical researcher just like me, and when Louisa was old enough to go to school, he hoped you'd be her very first teacher.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Those were the very last words he said to his daughter before he suddenly went to the Institute that night.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Oh, doctor, here you are! Perfect, if you were any later, the head caretaker would've gone ballistic.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Hm? Doctor, what's got your eyes all red? Did something happen?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Nothing. What's the matter?

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: It's time to make rounds.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I wasn't even paying attention... right, I understand.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Is there some kind of commotion over there?

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: Yes, seems an old nobleman's come from far off. Don't know for what.

steps.name: Elderly Caretaker
steps.text: As long as the days go by smooth, that's what matters.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Hello—

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Excuse me, we're currently making rounds... It seems you weren't on the list of scheduled visitors. Can I ask who you are?
Just an Ursus citizen here on a whim, looking to meet an old friend. Do carry on, madam.
I hope I don't bother any of you in your work.

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Witte, are you off?
No, old friend, I'll see you again in a bit. You should be more mindful of your health, with winter here. Don't set off that asthma of yours.
As you were, madam. I'll be waiting in the hall.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Minister Witte!
Do watch out.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Ah, I, sorry...

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: The Grand Duke didn't know you were visiting. It's our negligence on the job to blame. As a token of apology, the Grand Duke would like you to have dinner with him.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: We hope you understand, the Grand Duke is ill, and if not for that, he would've greeted you himself...

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Huff.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Ah, I'm sorry, I'm greatly sorry...

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: What's wrong with you! In the presence of the Minister—

steps.name: Veteran-Like Person
steps.text: Oh, nothing, just some alcohol spilled on the bedsheets.
Calm down. Madam, what happened?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: I'm sorry, the cap on the isopropyl bottle was too tight, and I applied too much force...
You could've just asked someone else to help.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Sorry, so sorry, I'll go and fetch a towel right now...
Poor her.
As for the Grand Duke's invitation, I do regret that my Messenger is still waiting for me, and I can't stay so long.

Do pass a message on to Vanya. Tell him to rest up with peace of mind here. Though he should remember, also, that this is a meritorious place for those Our Majesty gives favor, and not another social hub for the nobility to mingle in.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Ah... got it, got it... if you could just hold on... the Grand Duke will be very sad to hear.
This is official business. If I have to choose between Our Majesty and the Grand Duke, I'm forced to wrong the Grand Duke Vanya.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: Ergh...! You should've spoke sooner! If that's so, the Grand Duke will surely empathize with you.

steps.name: Ursus Officer
steps.text: May your road be evergreen.
Send him my regards.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. Louisa, what's wrong...?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Kal'tsit, who is he?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Viscount Islam Witte.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: You recognize him...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ursus's new Minister of Finance, a fresh noble with deep favor from the Emperor.

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's alright, Dr. Louisa.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have only surface knowledge of his character, and don't know specifically how he made his fortune. But what I do know is, he's a present pillar who the Emperor of Ursus has personally assisted.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And young elites like him can only have their sights set on the whole of Ursus. To the waves of crisis crashing against the Empire, the crises of Chernobog are mere tiny ripples.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even a Grand Duke of Ursus—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Hold on... hold on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Minister of Finance came to Pine Valley, yet has no armed entourage?

steps.name: Lillia
steps.text: Oh... I don't think so.
